global: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with halved soft-boiled eggs and tender chashu pork arranged atop. Sliced green onions and bean sprouts garnish the bowl, set against a dark woven mat under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Dark woven placemat with textured, patterned surface, appearing slightly uneven and fibrous in its fabric weave.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Clear, golden broth with thin noodles, garnished with green onions and soft-boiled egg halves, glistening under light.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows creamy white albumen and runny orange yolk with a glossy surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, round slice with a glossy, caramelized surface and visible fat marbling.
